mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below its 12-month moving average compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 7.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that precede corporate earnings contraction, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through reduced consumer spending confidence.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 7.5%, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days through reduced corporate revenue visibility.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO below 100) during manufacturing contraction periods signals reduced corporate output capacity, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days through lower earnings growth expectations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 100, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in real GDP growth (GDPC1 above 1.5% annualized) signals expanding economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days through improved profit visibility.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 1.5% annualized, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating monthly CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL change > 2.5%) signals persistent price pressures that prompt Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days through higher real interest rates.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.0%), declining non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signal worsening labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and generate negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 7.0% and PAYEMS declines, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production below 98.0 (INDPRO < 98.0) indicates manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate output and generates negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days through immediate earnings pressure.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 98.0, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.
